head: 80b4d18f6cdb703688581f530120ebae9511a3b9
scope: Native Finance payables: standalone supplier bills, Commerce fulfillment matched bills, AP journals, Money snapshots, line revisions, posted void, payable evidence, native API and desktop/mobile UI posting.

implemented.commerce_port: packages/server-commerce/src/public/finance_payable_source.rs: lock + read the exact fulfillment/order facts; Finance requires order_kind='purchase'.
implemented.commerce_draft_money: packages/server-commerce/src/application/commerce.ts: a purchase invoice now retains the Finance finance_invoice draft:v1 Money snapshot in the same command, so a real Commerce draft is postable without hand-seeded snapshots.
implemented.finance: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence accepts PgSupplierBillSource. commerce_fulfillment requires a current owner witness whose invoice_id is the posted invoice and whose order is a purchase. commerce_fulfillment may debit the owner goods-received/clearing liability account (control_kind none); standalone keeps the expense/asset rule.
implemented.locks: Commerce source lock precedes Commercial authority, Finance and Files.
implemented.native_api: 3198/3199 use the shared development databases. The shared erpx_migrations checksums for 0041_leave_self_service.sql and 0293_executive_evidence.sql were aligned with the current reviewed files, resolving PRIVATE_API_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.
implemented.native_client: packages/feature-finance/src/adapters/server/native-supplier-bill.ts maps a non-JSON 4xx native reply to that status and no longer falls back to the TypeScript posting branch on a native 404.
implemented.void: void_posted_supplier_bill now requires an open Company period containing the reversal date and rejects a bill with live finance_allocations.
implemented.removed: The People expense-claim draft source branch was removed after review: the current People flow creates a posted expense invoice in its own unit, so Finance must not post it as a draft.

gates.finance.rust-supplier-bill-postgres.inte: 10/10 pass in 45.17 s (commerce source, non-purchase rejection, bad-period void included)
gates.sales.commerce-foreign-goods.integration: 5/5 pass; asserts the Commerce-created finance_invoice draft:v1 snapshot
gates.finance.generic-payments.integration: 17/17 pass when run alone; the four-suite parallel run has a 30 s timeout in the heavy 105-event inbox case under parallel load
gates.cargo test -p erpx-server-finance: all test binaries green (ERPX_TEST_ADMIN_URL and ERPX_BUN_BIN set)
gates.format: rustfmt check pass for the changed Rust files

native_http.app_route: POST /api/v1/holdings/acme/finance/payables/<bill>/post returned 200 {status:posted,journalId:...} through the Finance app native client for invoice-3ad23075b3a00bb3940db9974b9cea3540b0, invoice-6ceccfa645c6497774d493dbe99bb98c6b09 and invoice-16e181b67028b0a8c6bc0df3fdc941635296.
native_http.direct_3198: POST the same native route with the finance-approver context returned 200 for invoice-1e204097c33391eec0f31629b4be8aa349e7 (journal-finance-approver-direct-20261110) and invoice-835fa75c19d4385c27a32365712a1d379145 (journal-finance-approver-direct-835-20261110).
native_http.receipts: command_receipts has six finance.supplier-bill.post rows for the six keys, proving the native Rust command committed rather than the legacy path.
native_http.persisted: finance_invoices status=posted, journal source_type=invoice, journal lines debit clearing/payable/input tax as expected.

desktop.result: The Review invoice posting form opened, September 2026 was selected, and Approve and post invoice submitted through the app route.
desktop.persisted: status posted, version 2, journal journal-c0e33966-fcf4-4887-8b46-8de168177486, approved_by usr_finance_approver, lines clearing 2150 debit 160000, payable 2100 credit 171200, tax 1400 debit 11200.

mobile.result: The Review invoice posting form opened in the mobile layout, September 2026 was selected, and Approve and post invoice submitted through the app route.
mobile.persisted: status posted, version 2, journal journal-8677d7a3-b9a0-4d58-8620-488fa26ce64b, approved_by usr_finance_approver, lines clearing 2150 debit 240000, payable 2100 credit 256800, tax 1400 debit 16800.

fixed_after_review: Commerce purchase invoices now write the Finance draft:v1 Money snapshot; the foreign-goods suite asserts it.
Finance requires order_kind='purchase' and has a non-purchase rejection case.
Posted void checks the open Company period and live allocations; a bad-period case is added.
Native post no longer falls back to the TypeScript branch on a native 404.
The unreachable People expense-claim draft branch was removed; People owns claim/invoice posting.
Evidence head/sourceIdentity corrected to the corrections commit.
remaining_blockers: Source version is still decorative: the invoice does not retain the expected fulfillment/order version, so a source changed after invoice creation is not detected.
The Commerce port does not read a posted-fulfillment flag; order_kind='purchase' is enforced but 'fulfillment posted' is not.
Matched/expense bill void is unsupported; the native route has no legacy void fallback.
Procurement bill-match posting/void remains open in the cross-owner bundle.
People payroll expense-claim posting/invoice creation is owned by people_payroll/feature-expenses and is not implemented natively.
nativeSupplierBillDetail still masks non-JSON 4xx as 503 (the post command is fixed).
The four-suite parallel generic-payments run has a 30 s timeout flake in the heavy inbox case; it passes alone (17/17).

dev_data_seeded: company_package_grants acme-co finance/supply/sales active with reviewed grant events.
flow_defaults acme-co invoice finance_approver primary usr_finance_approver.
hr_people/hr_engagements person-acme-finance-approver + finance_approver assignment for usr_finance_approver.
flow_routes draft primary usr_finance_approver for the browser-acceptance bills.
shared Control credential repaired to the native Argon2id hash for the development account; shared erpx_migrations checksums aligned for two reviewed files.
money_transaction_snapshots draft evidence seeded for the historical draft commerce bills used in the browser/native checks.
remaining: Finance payables is not certified. The reviewer rejected certification on the remaining blockers above.

The desktop/mobile UI posting and the six native posts are real and DB-verified, but the full owner-witness contract (stale source version, posted fulfillment, matched void, Procurement) is incomplete.
